SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future. SSC Space Connect is looking for a commercially driven and customer-focused Head of Market Region EMEA to lead and coordinate business development and sales activities across Europe and the Middle East. You have the ability to combine strategic market thinking with hands-on business development, and you enjoy building long-term relationships with customers, partners and internal stakeholders. We Believe You Have Several years of experience from business development, sales, key account management or commercial leadership in a technical or engineering-driven environment. Proven ability to lead teams both locally and remotely, coach commercial talent and create alignment across functions in the context of cultural and geographical diversity. Strong business acumen, negotiation skills and ability to identify profitable opportunities. Experience from the space sector, satellite communications, ground segment services, aerospace, defence or another advanced technology field is considered a strong advantage. A relevant university degree is preferred; however, candidates with equivalent professional experience will also be considered. Ability to understand complex technical concepts and translate them into customer value. Excellent communication skills in English; additional EMEA-region languages are an advantage. High integrity, strong judgement and ability to operate in environments with security-sensitive information. Lead, coordinate and develop business development and sales work across the EMEA market region. Drive sustainable growth, order intake, revenue and profitability through strong market presence and customer focus. Develop and maintain strategic customer relationships with institutional, governmental and commercial space customers. Ensure high-quality account planning, capture planning, forecasting and opportunity management. Support and coach regional business development directors, sales engineers and key account managers. Represent SSC Space at customer meetings, industry events, conferences and strategic partner discussions. Contribute to market intelligence, competitive analysis and regional business strategy. Ensure that sales activities follow SSC’s processes, governance, security requirements and business ethics. Work closely with internal stakeholders across operations, engineering, service delivery, legal, finance and strategy to create commercially and technically sound customer solutions. Benefits WE OFFER YOU At SSC, you will be part of an international space company with a long history of enabling critical missions and services for institutional and commercial customers around the world. Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program. Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams. Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance. LOCATION This is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in either Solna or Kiruna. This position requires approved pre-employment screening. These controls are based on the role that you will fulfill within the company. Additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space. We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

Proficient in Microsoft Office and treasury systems. Willingness to travel as required.
